session.description: Cookie appears to be a session identifier but lacks the 'HttpOnly' flag.
session.remediation: Configure the 'Set-Cookie' header to include the 'HttpOnly' attribute. This prevents client-side scripts (e.g. XSS) from reading the session cookie.

session.description: Cookie domain '.example.com' starts with a leading dot, making it accessible to all subdomains.
session.remediation: Omit the 'Domain' attribute completely to lock the cookie to the host that set it, or specify the exact hostname without a leading dot.
